ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: In the image, two cascaded 4-to-1 MUXes can be seen. The data inputs of the left MUX from I0 to I3 are connected to 0, 1, 1, 0 respectively; its selection terminals S1 and S0 are controlled by A and B respectively, and the output is labeled Y. The left output Y is connected by a wire to the selection terminal S1 of the right MUX; the other selection terminal S0 of the right MUX is controlled by C. The data inputs of the right MUX from I0 to I3 are also connected to 0, 1, 1, 0 respectively, and the right output is connected to X. For a 4-to-1 MUX, if the selection terminals S1S0 are 00, 01, 10, 11, then I0, I1, I2, I3 are selected respectively. Since the data inputs are 0, 1, 1, 0, the output is 1 only when the selection terminals are 01 or 10, that is, when the two selection signals are different. Therefore the left MUX output Y = A ⊕ B. The selection signals of the right MUX are Y and C, and the same data inputs 0, 1, 1, 0 make its output X = Y ⊕ C. Substituting Y = A ⊕ B gives X = A ⊕ B ⊕ C. The minterms for which the three-input XOR is 1 are 001, 010, 100, 111, so X = A\overline{B}\overline{C} + \overline{A}B\overline{C} + \overline{A}\overline{B}C + ABC.

method.method_draft: First describe the circuit structure from the image: two 4-to-1 MUX blocks in cascade, both loaded with data inputs 0,1,1,0. Apply the MUX selection rule to the left block with selects A,B to get Y=1 only for AB=01 or 10, so Y=A⊕B. Then apply the same rule to the right block, whose selects are Y and C, so X=1 only when Y and C differ: X=Y⊕C. Substitute Y=A⊕B and expand the three-input XOR to obtain X=A\overline{B}\overline{C}+\overline{A}B\overline{C}+\overline{A}\overline{B}C+ABC.
method.CoT_raw:
图像中可见两个级联的 4-to-1 MUX。左侧 MUX 的数据输入从 I0 到 I3 分别接 0、1、1、0；其选择端 S1、S0 分别由 A、B 控制，输出标为 Y。左侧输出 Y 通过连线接到右侧 MUX 的选择端 S1；右侧 MUX 的另一个选择端 S0 由 C 控制。右侧 MUX 的数据输入从 I0 到 I3 也分别接 0、1、1、0，右侧输出接到 X。

对 4-to-1 MUX，若选择端 S1S0 为 00、01、10、11，则分别选择 I0、I1、I2、I3。由于数据输入为 0、1、1、0，输出为 1 仅在选择端为 01 或 10 时成立，也就是两个选择信号不同。因此左侧 MUX 输出 Y = A ⊕ B。右侧 MUX 的选择信号为 Y 和 C，同样的数据输入 0、1、1、0 使其输出为 X = Y ⊕ C。代入 Y = A ⊕ B，得到 X = A ⊕ B ⊕ C。三输入异或为 1 的最小项是 001、010、100、111，所以 X = A\overline{B}\overline{C} + \overline{A}B\overline{C} + \overline{A}\overline{B}C + ABC。
